scope: Qualification-only native phone Requests coordinator; source/disposable embedded-core/QUIC, not app/physical acceptance
observations: A native review retains the exact signed List/Approve/Reject command, profile storage ID, enrollment binding, grant, nonce, digest, expiry and target before first dispatch.
Presence unavailable/denied or changed review refuses before Execute. No production presence implementation or mutation IPC was added.
Exact List and Reject are exercised, and an actual candidate completes approval/enrollment despite a lost controller reply.
After lost Execute/Result replies and reopen, the same native key, membership, nonce and digest remain; only Result for that exact operation is sent and Execute count stays one.
An independent local approval can produce the exact desired paired membership while the unobserved client operation remains uncertain because its own host result is missing.
A changed live candidate is not consumed, invited or approved. The original command is reserved once and retained as unconfirmed without replay.
Grant revocation before presence/dispatch and fresh core controller revocation refuse Execute. Expired/revoked grants preserve prior terminal outcomes as history without current confirmation.
Revocation immediately after dispatch preserves the exact returned outcome as historical evidence while withholding current confirmation.
Explicit retirement requires a fresh terminal readback and current grant, retains history, and creates no new operation automatically.
Journal tests cover context/profile changes, reply/session ordering, clock/expiry, signature/phase corruption, initialized missing history and failed durable reservation with no dispatch permission.
integration_fix: Preparing an approved candidate refreshes bridge credentials and can close the controller connection while approval continues. Failed transport remains durable uncertainty; after an exact reply, failed current membership/grant refresh preserves the result only as history.

automation.commands: Explicit default-off gate, qualified journal, client_enrollment, owner_control and owner_client_commands targets
